name: Biomedix Medical
old_description: Full service – sale, repair, lease, and purchase of used equipment.
about:
Biomedix Medical operates from Avondale, Pennsylvania, as a Pennsylvania corporation specializing in service-based medical equipment support. The company serves EMS, homecare, hospital, and veterinary clinic customers across the United States, its territories, Canada, and Mexico.

The business provides full-service sale, repair, lease, and purchase of used medical equipment. Its repair capabilities cover infusion pumps, syringe pumps, feeding pumps, defibrillators, pulse oximeters, patient monitors, SCD pumps, and transport and portable ventilators. The company also buys, sells, rents, and leases surplus medical equipment, and offers preventative maintenance and service programs. Product categories include ambulatory pumps, disposables, feeding pumps, infusion pumps (33 models), parts and accessories (20 models), SCD pumps, and syringe pumps (13 models). All products are sold patient-ready with a six-month warranty unless otherwise noted.

Biomedix Medical’s customer base spans the healthcare industry, including emergency medical services, homecare providers, hospitals, and veterinary clinics. The company ships equipment throughout the United States, U.S. territories, Canada, and Mexico.

The company’s stated mission is to provide high-quality refurbished medical equipment to the healthcare industry at affordable prices while delivering great service for medical device repair.

name: Bison Woodworks
old_description: We are a Family owned and operated custom woodworking company that specializes in custom cabinetry, interior doors, and other fine woodworking products.
about:
Bison Woodworks, a family-owned custom woodworking shop, operates from Eureka, Montana. The company was established in January 2017 as Eash & Miller Woodworks by Eli Eash, a former commercial logger turned custom home builder, and his brother-in-law Ryan Miller. After more than a decade in finish carpentry, Eash recognized a shortage of local cabinet makers amid a growing custom home market and launched the venture with Miller.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, interior doors, and other fine woodworking products for residential projects. While specific equipment and facility details are not disclosed, the operation emphasizes finish carpentry and custom millwork tailored to individual home designs.

Primary customers include custom home builders and homeowners in the Eureka region seeking bespoke cabinetry and door solutions. The company's founding was driven by demand from the local custom home market.

The founders cite a commitment to a high standard of quality and problem-solving as their guiding principle, with Ryan Miller having upheld that standard for seven years before departing in mid-2024, when the business adopted the Bison Woodworks name.

name: Black Diamond Woodworks LLC
old_description: Insured Independent Contractor with over 30 years of construction and carpentry experience offering General Contracting and Sub-Contract Carpentry services to the Gallatin Valley.
about:
Black Diamond Woodworks LLC operates from Bozeman, Montana, serving the Gallatin Valley. The company brings over 30 years of construction and carpentry experience and has been a registered independent contractor for more than 15 years.

The firm provides general contracting and sub-contract carpentry services, including finish carpentry, millwork installation, and lead carpenter support. Its custom woodworking shop produces built-in furniture such as window benches, entertainment centers, hutches, and bookcases, as well as freestanding pieces like conference tables, desks, and chests crafted from barnwood, white oak, reclaimed fir, and aromatic cedar. Additional capabilities cover log work, treehouse design and build, antique repair, and outdoor structures such as pergolas, sheds, and hot tub steps. The company maintains a fully equipped off-site workshop, a service truck, and an equipment shed to support turnkey residential projects.

Clients range from homeowners undertaking kitchen and bath remodels to builders needing specialized carpentry subcontractors. Past projects include a grain-flow white oak sideboard, a reclaimed yellow pine conference table, a D-log re-stack with garage door overlay, and a barnwood exterior door. The company also serves customers seeking custom mantels, hearth pads, and Z-brace doors.

Black Diamond Woodworks distinguishes itself with a choice of cost-plus-percentage-fee or fixed-price bidding, a fully insured operation, and an emphasis on clear communication and organized project management. The team’s deep experience in both structural and finish carpentry allows them to handle projects from initial framing through final millwork installation.

name: Blackhawk Molding Co
old_description: At Blackhawk Molding we take pride in our production process. Please see the short animation for more.
about:
Blackhawk Molding Co operates from Mayflower, Arkansas, where it has built over 75 years of capping excellence. The company describes itself as providing a family-oriented environment that blends a positive work atmosphere with strong employee support, though it does not disclose a specific founding year or founder names.

The company specializes in injection molding of closures for the dairy, juice, and water industries, producing tamper-evident caps and offering assembly, closure decoration, and label production. Its capabilities include an in-house toolroom, design and development of value-added packaging, and a technical service team that conducts preliminary surveys, bottle blowing for neck sizing, equipment auditing, and conversion assistance. Blackhawk markets itself as the world's provider of 55 mm closures.

Primary customers are bottlers in the dairy, juice, water, and broader beverage sectors. The technical team works directly with blow-mold operators and equipment vendors to ensure proper neck finishes and cap performance, serving both new and existing accounts.

Blackhawk emphasizes environmental sustainability through lightweight caps that reduce resin consumption and the SafeGard Plus cap, which incorporates calcium carbonate as a resin additive to cut plastic waste. The company also highlights its family-oriented culture and intellectual property development as differentiators.

name: Blazer Electric Supply Company Colorado Springs
about:
Blazer Electric Supply operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado. The current incarnation of the company was established in 2009 by Mike and Steve Blazer, who had originally founded the business in 1984 alongside their brother Fred. That first venture grew into the largest electrical distributor in Southern Colorado before being sold in 1999. A decade later, the Blazer brothers re-entered the market with 30 former employees and rebuilt the operation.

Today the company functions as a wholesale electrical distributor, stocking roughly $5 million of inventory across an 83,000-square-foot warehouse served by more than 90 associates. Beyond standard product distribution — spanning categories such as conduit, wire, lighting, control automation, and renewable-energy components — Blazer provides job-site services including storage containers, inventory management, and project staging. A dedicated ProFab department offers laser engraving, while a rental fleet and after-hours delivery (Night Strike) and 24/7 express pickup (Beep & Beep) round out the service portfolio.

The distributor’s customer base centers on the renewable-energy sector and the broader electrical construction trade, serving contractors, project managers, and industrial facilities throughout Southern Colorado and the Denver metro area. Its product lines cover data and telecom, power distribution, fire alarm, and safety equipment, reflecting the needs of commercial and industrial projects.

Blazer emphasizes its independence as a locally owned operation, arguing that this structure enables faster decision-making and tailored service. The company points to a string of industry awards — including multiple IMARK Distributor of the Year honors and a second-place ranking in a national customer-satisfaction survey of over 50 distributors — as evidence of its service focus.

name: Blissmade Furniture Co.
old_description: Inspired by the construction of early American timber frames and cabins. The simplicity and durability of the traditional joinery in this collection is a defining feature of the aesthetic.
about:
Blissmade Furniture Co. operates from Dunbarton, New Hampshire, where it designs and builds heirloom furniture and cabinetry. The company focuses on premium native hardwoods and traditional joinery techniques inspired by early American timber frames and cabins.

The product line spans six distinct collections—Bay Point, Early American, Galehead, Studio Craft, Lakehouse, and Shaker Harvest—each drawing on historical American furniture styles. In addition to case goods, the company reproduces solid brass hardware using traditional patterns. Production relies on hand-fitted joinery and solid-wood construction rather than veneers or particle board.

Blissmade serves residential clients, interior designers, and architects seeking historically accurate pieces for period homes and new builds. The collections are marketed as heirloom-grade furnishings built to withstand seasonal changes and generations of use.

The company emphasizes the simplicity and durability of traditional joinery as its defining aesthetic, positioning each piece as a modern continuation of early American craft traditions.
